growth.note: The bound applies to every fixture measured at more than one size, and it is 1.25 because the cost per plan entry has to stay flat as the fleet grows: `fleet` grows the number of entries and keeps each entry's own work constant, `mesh` grows one entry's work with the fleet and keeps the plan linear in it, and a quarter of slack absorbs constant-factor noise without admitting any super-linear term.

worked.note: Moved by hold-every-stated-guarantee: the deployment half of a declaration is read through the guarded reader the module half already used, every name entering a key is held to the key grammar, and every interface the deployment reaches earns its rows rather than only the interfaces the deployment attributed. The cost is about 7% per plan entry at every one of 4, 16, 64 and 256, so it is a constant added to the reading of one entry rather than a new term in how the reading grows.
